steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen for a pricing-stage column test.
Provide the mandatory event title required for a valid create flow.
Apply an RFQ/Auction pricing template so Column settings and its columns are available.
Add a line item so the pricing sheet renders.
Populate the pricing sheet and establish the initial column state.
Assert that the template produced at least one pricing-sheet column before testing column settings.

args.goal: On the pricing sheet, record the initial column count, open the three-dots menu next to Column settings, choose Duplicate, and verify the column count increases by one and a copied column appears; then open the three-dots menu on a column, choose Delete, and verify the column count decreases by one and that column is removed; stop on the pricing sheet showing the final columns.

steps.note: Perform and observe the catalog-missing Duplicate and Delete column actions and their count changes directly on the buyer's screen.
Assert that the pricing sheet remains rendered with columns after the duplicate and delete operations.
